message: Implemented `clamp` in mathutil.py: raises `ValueError` if `low > high`, otherwise returns `value` bounded to `[low, high]`.
diff:
diff --git a/mathutil.py b/mathutil.py
index dd892d7..42a8197 100644
--- a/mathutil.py
+++ b/mathutil.py
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
 def clamp(value: float, low: float, high: float) -> float:
     # raise ValueError if low > high
-    ...
+    if low > high:
+        raise ValueError("low must be <= high")
+    return max(low, min(value, high))
